order_book_source.bootstrap_rule: complete two-sided checkpoint plus first following diff with pu == snapshot_last_update_id
order_book_source.healthy_replay_rule: later snapshots are audit-only; authoritative state advances through continuous pu -> u diffs
order_book_source.gap_rule: pu sequence gap or crossed reconstructed book invalidates state until a later valid checkpoint handshake
order_book_source.quantity_rule: diff quantities are absolute; zero removes the price level

marketable_execution.rule: walk visible opposite-side depth at arrival timestamp

latency.rule: every component must be explicit nonnegative integer nanoseconds

costs.taker_fee_bps: explicit assumption required for total cost
costs.funding_bps: explicit signed assumption; source timing deferred until a position specification requires it

audit_only.note: The zero-latency profile and 1000-USDT notional exercise replay/fill coverage only. They are not a registered strategy latency or position size.

freshness.rule: record exact state age; a future registered strategy must pre-specify any maximum acceptable age

future_strategy_outcomes.rule: economic return/outcome measurement must begin no earlier than executable_entry_ts_ns for the registered latency/fill model
future_strategy_outcomes.note: R0.3 anchor+3s labels remain corrected legacy scientific labels; they are not an executable entry price under nonzero latency.
